advance_plan_gift_check.name: advance_plan_gift_check
advance_plan_gift_check.value: ("advance_campaign_plans"."gift_config"->>'activityType' = 'GIFT_DISTRIBUTION' AND "advance_campaign_plans"."gift_config"->>'channel' IN ('DIRECT', 'INSTITUTION') AND "advance_campaign_plans"."gift_config"->>'checklistVersion' = 'gift.v1' AND jsonb_typeof("advance_campaign_plans"."gift_config"->'stages') = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length("advance_campaign_plans"."gift_config"->'stages') > 0) IS TRUE

advance_plan_freeze_check.name: advance_plan_freeze_check
advance_plan_freeze_check.value: ("advance_campaign_plans"."frozen_at" IS NULL AND "advance_campaign_plans"."plan_hash" IS NULL AND "advance_campaign_plans"."frozen_plan_bytes" IS NULL AND "advance_campaign_plans"."draft_key" IS NULL AND "advance_campaign_plans"."organizer_wallet" IS NULL) OR ("advance_campaign_plans"."frozen_at" IS NOT NULL AND "advance_campaign_plans"."plan_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "advance_campaign_plans"."plan_hash" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "advance_campaign_plans"."plan_hash" !~ '^0x0+$' AND "advance_campaign_plans"."frozen_plan_bytes" IS NOT NULL AND "advance_campaign_plans"."draft_key" IS NOT NULL AND "advance_campaign_plans"."draft_key" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "advance_campaign_plans"."draft_key" !~ '^0x0+$' AND "advance_campaign_plans"."organizer_wallet" IS NOT NULL AND "advance_campaign_plans"."organizer_wallet" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{40}$' AND "advance_campaign_plans"."organizer_wallet" !~ '^0x0+$')

hed_campaign_draft_freeze_check.name: hed_campaign_draft_freeze_check
hed_campaign_draft_freeze_check.value: ("hed_campaign_drafts"."frozen_at" IS NULL AND "hed_campaign_drafts"."commitment_hash" IS NULL) OR ("hed_campaign_drafts"."frozen_at" IS NOT NULL AND "hed_campaign_drafts"."commitment_hash" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "hed_campaign_drafts"."commitment_hash" !~ '^0x0+$')

hed_request_draft_freeze_check.name: hed_request_draft_freeze_check
hed_request_draft_freeze_check.value: ("hed_request_drafts"."frozen_at" IS NULL AND "hed_request_drafts"."request_hash" IS NULL) OR ("hed_request_drafts"."frozen_at" IS NOT NULL AND "hed_request_drafts"."request_hash" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "hed_request_drafts"."request_hash" !~ '^0x0+$')

organization_requests_submission_check.name: organization_requests_submission_check
organization_requests_submission_check.value: ("organization_verification_requests"."status" = 'DRAFT' AND "organization_verification_requests"."submitted_at" IS NULL AND "organization_verification_requests"."snapshot_bytes" IS NULL AND "organization_verification_requests"."snapshot_hash" IS NULL) OR ("organization_verification_requests"."status" <> 'DRAFT' AND "organization_verification_requests"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "organization_verification_requests"."snapshot_bytes" IS NOT NULL AND "organization_verification_requests"."snapshot_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "organization_verification_requests"."snapshot_hash" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$')

organization_requests_decision_check.name: organization_requests_decision_check
organization_requests_decision_check.value: ("organization_verification_requests"."status" IN ('APPROVED','CHANGES_REQUESTED','REJECTED') AND "organization_verification_requests"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "organization_verification_requests"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "organization_verification_requests"."review_note" IS NOT NULL AND length("organization_verification_requests"."review_note") > 0) OR ("organization_verification_requests"."status" NOT IN ('APPROVED','CHANGES_REQUESTED','REJECTED') AND "organization_verification_requests"."reviewed_at" IS NULL AND "organization_verification_requests"."reviewed_by" IS NULL AND "organization_verification_requests"."review_note" IS NULL)
